INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_DIALOGUE.title: Play special card dialogue
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_DIALOGUE.hover.de: When disabled, dialogue bubbles triggered by Indomitable card presentations will not be shown.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_SOUND_EFFECTS.hov: When disabled, custom voice lines and sounds triggered by Indomitable card presentations will be muted, but can still use the default animation sound.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_SPECIAL_CARD_ANIM: When enabled, Indomitable in certain outfits performs a unique animation when playing specific cards. When disabled, the normal animation plays instead. Combat victory animations are unaffected.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_HYPNOTIZED_ANIMAT: When enabled, a special animation plays if available when a player's Hypnotized reaches 5 stacks and triggers its effect. This setting only affects animations, not the effects of Hypnotized.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_SPECIAL_LINE_ONCE: Play each card's special line once per combat

When enabled, each card type's special dialogue and audio share one use per combat. After that use, playing the same card type again uses the default animation sound. The limit resets when you enter or leave combat, including after loading a save.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LUCKY_BAG_RELIC_RULE.h: Collect automatically: receive the gift immediately. Allow skipping and return: skipped gifts remain available. Allow skipping and destroy: skipped gifts are consumed as if collected, without granting the relic or its effects. Skipping still uses Lucky Bag's activation for this shop. In multiplayer, the host's setting applies.
